query:
SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS "count!"
           FROM rev.object_paths op
           WHERE op.namespace_company_id = $1::UUID
             AND op.created_at >= (
                 SELECT MIN(op2.created_at) FROM rev.object_paths op2
                 JOIN rev.versioned_objects vo ON vo.path_id = op2.id
                 WHERE vo.path_id = $2
             )
